wallpapers.title: The quiet power of an unclaimed world
wallpapers.caption: World Environment Day
wallpapers.desc: If nature had a 'do not disturb' sign, it would hang over Sarek National Park, often called 'the last European wilderness.' On World Environment Day, this remote corner of Swedish Lapland reminds us what the planet looks like when humans take a step back—and let the wild take the lead.
